title: Stacker
description: Stop the sliding blocks at the right moment and stack them to the top of the tower. A classic arcade timing game, free in your browser.
about:
Stacker brings the classic arcade prize machine to your browser. A row of glowing blocks slides from side to side, and you tap to drop it on top of the row below. Stack all ten rows to reach the top and win the major prize.

Timing is everything: any block that does not land on the stack flashes and falls away, so your row gets narrower every time you are off. The machine also narrows the row on its own as you climb: three blocks at the bottom, two from the third row and a single block from the sixth row up. If you miss completely the game is over. The rows speed up as the tower grows, and the highlighted lines on the board mark the minor prize on row 7 and the major prize at the top.

A round takes less than a minute, your best height and number of wins are saved, and it plays just as well with a mouse, a keyboard or a finger.
howToPlay: Press Play, then tap anywhere on the board, click, or press Space to stop the moving row of blocks. Only the blocks that land on top of the row below stay; the rest fall off and your row gets shorter. Reach row 7 for the minor prize and the top row to win the major prize; if no block lands on the stack, the game is over. Press Again to start a new round.
tips: Watch the row move a couple of times before dropping, so you learn its rhythm.
The row moves in steps: drop just as it lands on the column you want.
The row narrows by itself on rows 3 and 6, so a miss there costs less than you think.
Near the top the rows are much faster, so focus on the single column under the moving block.

faq.question: Is Stacker free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. Stacker is completely free and runs in your browser, with no download or sign-up.

faq.question: Can I play on a phone or tablet?
faq.answer: Yes. Tap anywhere on the screen to drop the row; the board fills the screen in portrait and landscape.

faq.question: How do I win?
faq.answer: Stack the blocks all the way to the top row. Every missed block makes your row narrower, and the game ends when no block lands on the stack. Reaching row 7 earns the minor prize.
